title: Driftkings
author: Driftkings
changelog: Include the Windows installer for supported Wargaming installations (EU, NA and ASIA); verify the selected game root and version.
Fix unavailable target geometry and add a configurable native-target indicator color.
Improve statistics cache preservation and rating validation without changing valid-input formulas.
Consolidate battle Gameface lifecycle, Flash text rendering and numeric conversion; preserve feature-specific settings.
Use explicit imports and owned hooks, remove unused constants and replace legacy logging with visible exception reports.
Centralize recoverable file publication and preserve strict updater path and JSON validation.
Beta: visual in-game checks of the refactored panels and a new automatic-update installation test remain pending.
